cam.unsupported: The camera is not available. Allow it in iPhone Settings → GHOST, then reopen the app. You can still try the flow with Test swing.
cam.denied: Could not use the camera ({err}). Turn on iPhone Settings → GHOST → Camera. Meanwhile you can try the flow with Test swing.
cam.modelFail: Could not load the pose model. Close the app and open it again.
share.noRecord: This device cannot record the screen
share.lead: Records 10 seconds of the camera with a mask over your face, and checks that it can go to the iPhone share sheet. Nothing leaves the phone unless you tap Share. Before recording, make sure nobody else is in view.
soon.label: Opens in an update
setup.safety: Never use a real blade. Swing a bokuto, a broom or a towel. Keep more than arm-plus-weapon length clear in every direction, away from people, furniture and lights.
map.start.desc: Tap, take your stance, then one big swing. First stand your iPhone and clear the space.
start.cam.sub: Please wait until it is ready.
start.camOff.sub: Open iPhone Settings → GHOST → Camera, turn it on, then reopen the app.
start.body.sub: Step back until your shoulders, hands and hips are in view.
start.stance.sub: Hold both hands still below your shoulders. Is it clear above your head?
start.help: If you cannot raise your arms, use “Tap to start”
battle.place2: If the camera stays off: iPhone Settings → GHOST → Camera on
title.formnote: You can play YOKAI TAIJI right now. Later, record your own swings under Register forms. Enemy attacks can be turned off in Settings.
battle.gestureHelp: Hands-free: cross your forearms in front of your chest for 3 seconds to retreat. On the result screen, raise both hands above your head for 1 second for the next yokai (it also moves on by itself after 15 seconds), or cross your forearms to stop.
